description: This file defines an interface for retry filtering logic when attempting to connect to an Orleans cluster, along with a specific implementation that uses linear backoff retries.

classes.name: LinearBackoffClientConnectionRetryFilter
classes.description: An internal sealed class implementing a retry filter with linear backoff strategy for Orleans client connection attempts.

methods.name: ShouldRetryConnectionAttempt
methods.description: Determines whether to retry a connection attempt based on the exception and cancellation token, implementing a linear backoff delay.
